# awareness level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:awarenessLevel`](gmeow-awarenessLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/awarenessLevel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/awareness`](../../slices/awareness.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an experiencer — a [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md), or directly a process or agent — to its graded [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) (arousal / vigilance). The DOMAIN is left intentionally OPEN, exactly as [`gmeow:awarenessMode`](gmeow-awarenessMode.md), so the edge applies to a tenure or directly to an agent. NOT functional and VANTAGE-INDEXED ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). The named, ordinal companion of the continuous [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](gmeow-awarenessScalar.md) — supply either or both.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:awarenessLevel`](gmeow-awarenessLevel.md) from `?` to [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Sleep Episode

- **Source:** [`slices/core/awareness/examples/sleep-episode.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/awareness/examples/sleep-episode.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-awareness-examples-sleep-episode)#example-slices-core-awareness-examples-sleep-episode

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/awareness/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- The night-long sleep tenure: an agent in a mode over an interval.
ex:lillithSleep a gmeow:AwarenessTenure ;
    rdfs:label "Lillith's night of sleep"@en ;
    gmeow:awarenessSubject ex:lillith ;
    gmeow:awarenessMode    gmeow:modeAsleep ;
    gmeow:awarenessLevel   gmeow:levelUnresponsive ;
    gmeow:duringInterval   ex:nightInterval .

# --- A nested REM sub-tenure: rapid-eye-movement sleep, the vivid-dreaming stage.
#     The same agent, two co-applying modes (REM stage + dreaming), a shorter span
#     contained within the night interval.
ex:lillithREM a gmeow:AwarenessTenure ;
    rdfs:label "Lillith's REM episode"@en ;
    gmeow:awarenessSubject ex:lillith ;
    gmeow:awarenessMode    gmeow:modeREM , gmeow:modeDreaming ;
    gmeow:awarenessLevel   gmeow:levelUnresponsive ;
    gmeow:duringInterval   ex:remInterval .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the graded arousal of an experiencer on the named ladder — clinical-style alertness (alert, obtunded, unresponsive) on a [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md) or directly on an agent.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the qualitative state (that is [`gmeow:awarenessMode`](gmeow-awarenessMode.md)) and avoid forcing one level per subject (non-functional, vantage-indexed); for a continuous normalised arousal value reach for [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](gmeow-awarenessScalar.md).

### How to use

- Point the experiencer at a seeded [`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md) individual; read the ordering off [`gmeow:levelRank`](gmeow-levelRank.md), and supply [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](gmeow-awarenessScalar.md) alongside when a finer continuous value is available.

### Scope notes

- Ordinal arousal, distinct from mode ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): [`gmeow:awarenessLevel`](gmeow-awarenessLevel.md) grades HOW alert the experiencer is ([`gmeow:AwarenessLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AwarenessLevel.md)), where [`gmeow:awarenessMode`](gmeow-awarenessMode.md) names WHICH state it is in; the two co-apply on the same tenure. For a continuous value use [`gmeow:awarenessScalar`](gmeow-awarenessScalar.md).
